name: Kibet
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.note: Only Edgar 1991 Maba-group lexicon known; no grammar/phonology of Kibet located

sources.note: Catalog: dialects Dagel, Murru, Nuclear Kibet; most extensive descriptions: Nougayrol 1986 (phonology or text collection), Doornbos & Bender 1983 (wordlist), Johnes 1854 (wordlist).

sources.citation: Weiss, Doris. 2009. Phonologie et morphosyntaxe du maba. Thèse, Université Lumière Lyon 2.
sources.note: Maba (maba1277) only; the word 'Kibet' does not occur in the text. Not a Kibet source.
Phonology section (consonants, vowels; 'There are two tones: high and low.') is cited to Nougayrol 1989, i.e. Aiki/Runga data; no stress statement.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2021 (draft 10 Jan 2021). The Maban languages and their place within Nilo-Saharan. Cambridge: ms, 25 pp.
sources.note: Sec. 4.3 'Tones' covers Maba (H, L, rising, falling per Weiss 2009) and Aiki (two tone heights per Nougayrol 1989) only; Kibet forms in the comparative tables (from Doornbos 1979-81 field notes, informant Ahmad Xamiis of Am Timan) carry tone marks (gàmdí, sàd-í, fɔ́r-ɔ̀, wè-tә́m-ɛ̀). Nothing on Kibet stress. Bibliography lists SIL surveys Wolf, Bombay & Mbernodji 2006 and Mbernodji & Wolf 2008 on Kibet/Rounga/Daggal/Mourro.

tone.quote: La liste de mots utilisée pendant l'enquête contient 225 substantifs et verbes d'usage courant dans la vie sociale aussi que les nombres et les pronoms personnels [...] Listes de mots / parler: rounga | rounga | kibet | daggal | mourro / endroit: Batimere Rounga | Haraze Mangueigne | Ardo | Mouraye | Aboukoussoum [...] 17 nombril ˈʔadum | ʔadʊm | ʔaˈdʊm | ʔadʊm | ʔadəm / 18 dos siːda | sidaʔ̚ | sǐːdá | mundaŋ | sìdá [...] 23 peau ˈmadá | madá | ˈmadːa | ˈmadɛ | maˈdɛ [...] 25 sang fai | faɪ | faʔˈlu | faˈlo | faló [...] 35 oncle maternel tʰanám | tʰanam | tʰaˈnám | ˈtʰanam | namːa
tone.locator: sec. 4.4 'Listes de mots', p. 11; Annexe 'Listes de mots', pp. 44-45, items 17, 18, 23, 25, 35 (column separators added; third data column = kibet, Ardo)
tone.translation: The wordlist used during the survey contains 225 nouns and verbs in everyday social use as well as the numerals and personal pronouns [...] Wordlists / variety: rounga | rounga | kibet | daggal | mourro / place: ... [data rows: navel, back, skin, blood, maternal uncle]
tone.check: quotation verified in source (minor differences in wording)

sources.note: Full description of the sister dialect/language of the Runga-Kibet cluster (rung1258) with a tone/'accent' analysis (two registers H/L, leftward high-pitch displacement, p. 26 per Starostin); Nougayrol groups aiki, kibet, dagal, muru together (1986: 40) and the same analysis probably underlies his Kibet transcription. Not a Kibet source proper.

sources.note: Snippets: 'Кибет, или кабен [кбт]: ≈ 20000 носителей в регионе Вадаи. Этим языком также специально занимался П. Нугайроль, однако опубликована была только одна краткая статья [Nougayrol 1986]'; Maban tone overview: two-register system in Aiki [Nougayrol 1989: 26] apparently reconstructible to proto-Maba; Masalit contour tones arise at morpheme junctures. Nothing on stress.
